decision_detail: e2elb-c2-fix-direction: no further quota-increase or burst-reduction fix pursued at this time. Zero throttles at 68.9% of reference volume, at an unchanged TPM quota, is treated as a meaningfully different signal from the 22-day-stale 2026-06-26 reference burn, sufficient given the owner's stated priority on Continuity development over Nestfolio work. Monitor and revisit only if a future live e2e-feature-tests run against AWS actually throttles again; no scheduled re-measurement, no quota-increase request submitted, no burst-reduction implementation session opened as a result of this decision.
